name: Depositions, examinations and witness testimony
one_line: The file of ONE named individual's own sworn or attested evidence, taken outside a courtroom and recorded so that it can be quoted back word for word: the notice or subpoena that compelled the person, the certified verbatim transcript with its page-and-line addressing, the audio or video recording of the examination, the exhibits marked on the person during it, the errata sheet on which that person corrects their own recorded words, and the designations that later cite into it by coordinate. It also absorbs the legacy row law.witness-statements: a signed witness statement or proof of evidence is the drafted, non-verbatim form of the same thing, one person's own attested account, anchored on the person rather than on the matter. The row exists because its activation structure is NOT the schema's practitioner-and-client pair - the anchoring slot is a THIRD professional role, a reporter, notary, commissioner or examining officer who attests an oath and signs, and the person whose words are recorded is usually neither the practitioner nor the client - and because its privacy rule is specific to it: a certified transcript is a full verbatim record of one compelled non-party, and it ships with an alphabetical WORD INDEX, a machine-readable concordance of every name and term spoken. It does NOT hold the tribunal's own record of a hearing (law_practice.hearing-transcripts), written interrogatories and requests (law_practice.discovery), the schedule that spans several examinations (law_practice.evidence-exhibits), the expert's instruction and report (law_practice.expert-materials), or a notarised affidavit, whose jurat is `legal`'s own deterministic signal. Declares no field rows and no folder dimensions under PR-6.

proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key_works: ENDORSEMENT OF AN EXISTING PROPOSAL, NOT A MINT. `clinical_practice` proposed `subject_of_record` for the person a record is ABOUT as distinct from the person who holds it; `nonprofit` adopted it rather than minting `beneficiary`; the `law_practice` schema adopted it too and named the deponent as its example. This row is the PARADIGM CASE and is recorded so R1c can weigh the strongest instance rather than the average one: a deponent is compelled by a notice or subpoena, is frequently a NON-PARTY with no relationship to the holder, to the holder's client or to the litigation at all, and the entire artefact is that one person's verbatim words. `client` cannot hold them (they are often adverse, or on no side), `our_firm` cannot, `subject` is a topic key and not a person, and minting `deponent`, `witness`, `examinee` or `affiant` would be four names for one concept that already has one. The row explicitly DECLINES to mint any of those four.
proposed_fields.preferred_resolution: Adjudicate as ONE key with `clinical_practice`, `nonprofit` and the `law_practice` schema. This row adds one condition and no fork: `destination_eligible` must be FALSE, and the reason belongs on the key rather than on each template, because a folder named for a deponent writes a compelled non-party's identity into the filesystem where every later process reads it - against 00's "The default posture must therefore be local-first and data-minimizing." This row's own dimension recommendation is built around that ban (see template.why), so if the key is adopted as destination-eligible the recommendation here must be read as overriding it.
proposed_fields.why: The deponent is the field-shaped hole under this row's entire privacy claim, and the one person in the law_practice family who has no canonical key and no consent.

deterministic: PRECONDITION AND THE ROW'S WHOLE ARGUMENT. These are activation signals, not licences to write law_practice facts - the schema declares none. The discriminating structure is a CERTIFIED VERBATIM EXAMINATION RECORD, and it is a FOUR-SLOT structure that is deliberately NOT the schema's default pair. The schema's default requires (i) a matter reference repeated across artefacts and (ii) an artefact whose labelled slots separate a PRACTITIONER role from a CLIENT role. This row fires on neither: its anchoring slot is a THIRD professional role - a reporter, stenographer, notary, commissioner or examining officer - attesting that they administered an oath to a NAMED INDIVIDUAL, and the individual is usually neither the practitioner nor the client. A transcript served by opposing counsel may carry no reference of the holder's firm anywhere and still be unambiguously this row's. Apply the schema's deletion test unchanged: delete every entity name and every document-type word - the certificate slot, the oath attestation, the page-and-line addressing and the errata columns all survive, which is why this is a node and not a filename filter.

AN OFFICER'S CERTIFICATE: a signed block in which a person who is NOT a party and NOT counsel attests that they administered an oath or affirmation to a named individual, that the examination took place on a stated date at a stated place, that the pages are a true and correct record of the testimony, and that they have no interest in the outcome, together with their own commission, licence or registration reference and a date of signature. The three labelled professional roles on one page - officer, examining counsel, defending counsel - plus a fourth non-professional role, the person examined, is a role structure no other roster row produces. Read through 00's direct-fact path, a labelled form field.

AN APPEARANCES BLOCK WITH NO BENCH: a header listing who was present and in what capacity - counsel for each party, the reporter, a videographer, an interpreter, the deponent - and NO judicial officer, NO bench line, NO clerk and NO ruling. The ABSENCE of the tribunal here is not the row's evidence on its own (a row defined only by an absence would be refused); it is the discriminator applied AFTER the certificate slot has already fired, and it is the single thing that separates this row from `law_practice.hearing-transcripts` on identical-looking bytes.

PAGE-AND-LINE VERBATIM BODY: pages numbered on a two-axis coordinate system, line numbers running down the left margin, alternating `Q.` and `A.` prefixes, colloquy and objection interjections attributed by surname, and frequently a CONDENSED or four-up rendering of the same pages. Page-and-line addressing is what makes the artefact QUOTABLE, and it is the reason every downstream artefact in this family points INTO the file by coordinate rather than by paragraph. Numbered clauses, numbered paragraphs and numbered requests are other rows' structures and are not this one.

AN ERRATA, CORRECTION OR READ-AND-SIGN SHEET, and this is the row's most distinctive slot: a table whose columns are page, line, the words as recorded, the words as changed, and the reason for the change, signed and dated BY THE PERSON WHOSE WORDS THEY ARE. It is a record of one individual amending a record of themselves, and no pleading, order, exhibit schedule, expert report, discovery response, investigation note or hearing transcript in this roster produces it - a witness cannot correct a court's transcript this way, because the record belongs to the court. A read-and-sign WAIVER, a one-line slot stating that signature was waived, is the same slot in its negative form and counts equally.

A NOTICE OR SUBPOENA DIRECTED AT A NAMED NATURAL PERSON: an instrument compelling one individual to attend and answer orally at a stated date, time and place, naming the officer before whom the examination will be taken, and optionally attaching a schedule of documents that person must bring. The discriminator against `law_practice.discovery` is the DIRECTION AND THE OBJECT: a demand aimed at a PARTY to produce documents or answer in writing is discovery's; a demand aimed at a PERSON to appear and speak is this row's, and the attached schedule does not move it.

A DESIGNATION, COUNTER-DESIGNATION or CITE TABLE: a table whose columns are page-from, line-from, page-to, line-to, offering party, objection and ruling. It is structurally a table of COORDINATES INTO ANOTHER FILE and it is the clearest external proof that the page-and-line system is this family's real structure. The designation table is this row's; the trial bundle it is being prepared for is `law_practice.trial-preparation`'s.

A PROCEEDING RECORDING: an audio or video file whose extraction yields, per 00, "Audio and video files should yield duration, container and codec metadata, creation time, embedded tags, subtitles or captions where present, and—only under an explicit privacy and compute policy—speech-to-text transcripts." The examination is announced on the record at the head of the recording by the officer or videographer, and the file is usually one of several numbered media segments covering one day. This row is the only one in the law_practice family whose PRIMARY artefact family includes a recording, which is why 00's speech-to-text clause is a live constraint here and nowhere else in the family: the recording must not be transcribed to improve classification.

AN UNCERTIFIED ROUGH or REALTIME FEED: a plain-text or ASCII stream carrying the Q-and-A body and provisional page-and-line numbering, marked rough, uncertified, unedited or not for citation. It is the same examination before the certificate exists, and it belongs here as a version_family member of the certified transcript - supported by explicit revision or certification markers, never by a `-final` suffix.

A WITNESS STATEMENT, PROOF OF EVIDENCE or DECLARATION, which is how this row absorbs the legacy `law.witness-statements`: continuous first-person prose in numbered paragraphs, headed with the maker's name and address-for-service, exhibiting documents by an initials-and-number marker, and closing with a STATEMENT OF TRUTH or declaration block signed and dated by the maker. It is NOT verbatim and has no reporter, but it is the same underlying structure this row is built on - ONE NAMED INDIVIDUAL'S OWN ATTESTED EVIDENCE, SIGNED BY THAT INDIVIDUAL, ANCHORED ON THE PERSON RATHER THAN ON THE MATTER - and the signed statement of truth is the attestation slot in its self-administered form. Where a NOTARIAL JURAT is present instead, the document is an affidavit and `legal`'s own deterministic signal has fired; see collides_with.

AN ALPHABETICAL WORD INDEX bound at the back of a certified transcript: a concordance mapping every proper name and substantive term spoken to its page-and-line occurrences. It is a strong structural signal AND the row's sharpest privacy hazard simultaneously, and it is detected in order to be protected: it is the most extractable structure in the file and the one that must never be read as a source of facts, entities or prompt content.

AN EXAMINATION-PACKAGE ARCHIVE whose manifest, read WITHOUT unpacking, shows member paths encoding ONE person's name or examination reference across coherent members - a certified transcript, a condensed rendering, a word index, an exhibits folder, numbered media segments, an errata sheet. 00: "However, the normal scan should never extract archive contents to the filesystem, because doing so creates security, storage, and side-effect risks." Member paths are observations and become facts on no member.
needs_llm: SEPARATING AN OUT-OF-COURT EXAMINATION FROM THE TRIBUNAL'S OWN RECORD OF A HEARING. This is the row's sharpest over-firing risk and it is `law_practice.hearing-transcripts`' whole node from the other direction. Both are reporter-produced verbatim Q-and-A with page-and-line numbering and a certificate. The deciding evidence is a JUDICIAL PRESENCE in the header or body - a bench line, a presiding officer, rulings on objections made in the moment, opening and closing addresses - together with the presence or absence of an errata slot the witness may sign. Neither the word transcript nor a reporting company's footer decides anything.

DECIDING WHETHER A SIGNED WITNESS STATEMENT REALLY BELONGS WITH SWORN EXAMINATIONS AT ALL. The roster directs the legacy absorption and this row performs it, but the seam is genuinely thin and is surfaced rather than smoothed (see open_question): a statement is drafted, often by the practitioner, and only signed by the maker, whereas a deposition is the maker's own unedited words. The model must not treat drafting authorship as the test, because 00 forbids the destination use of that slot and because both artefacts carry the same producer metadata.

SEPARATING AN EXAMINATION FROM AN INVESTIGATION INTERVIEW. `law_practice.investigation` holds interview records that are also one person's account of events, and they defeat topic-based separation completely. The discriminators are structural: an investigation note is taken BY the investigator, is usually a summary rather than verbatim, has no oath, no officer, no page-and-line coordinates and no slot in which the interviewee corrects and signs. Where an interviewee HAS signed a verbatim record under an attestation, the two rows genuinely contest the file and the model should abstain rather than guess.

DECIDING WHETHER THE HOLDER IS PRACTITIONER-SIDE AT ALL. A certified transcript is served on every party and downloaded by non-parties; the same bytes sit in the practitioner's matter file, in the deponent's own records, in an expert's working set and in a journalist's folder. The schema's default pair is absent from the file itself, so this row's activation says nothing about the holder's role, and the model must not infer one. Where the holder appears to BE the deponent, `legal.personal-legal-matters` is the more specific home.

RECOGNISING AN EXAMINATION IN AN UNLABELLED OR JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC FORM - an examination for discovery, an examination under oath on an insurance claim, a statement taken under caution, a commission or letters-rogatory examination abroad, a taped interview transcribed by a secretary, a scanned and OCR'd stenographic original. Local interpretation or abstention only. This row defines no jurisdiction catalogue and no procedural rule, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension here.

SEPARATING AN OPERATIVE EXAMINATION FROM A TRAINING OR PUBLISHED EXEMPLAR. Advocacy courses, bar review providers, reporting companies and trial-skills programmes all publish complete sample transcripts with real-looking certificates. Topic will not separate them - purpose is the only test that works - and the exemplars in this family are unusually convincing because the profession publishes its own.

DECIDING WHETHER SEVERAL VOLUMES, DAYS, MEDIA SEGMENTS AND A ROUGH DRAFT ARE ONE EXAMINATION OR SEVERAL. A person may be examined twice in one matter, once in each of two related matters, and once as a fact witness and once as a corporate representative. Bridging by the person's name alone is forbidden however confident the model is - that is a privacy rule as much as an accuracy one.

ABSTAINING WHENEVER THE CERTIFICATE-OR-ATTESTATION SLOT CANNOT BE CITED. 00: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement." and "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."
never_alone: A PERSON'S NAME ALONE, IN ANY OF THIS ROW'S ROLES - deponent, witness, examining counsel, defending counsel, reporter, videographer, interpreter, expert. This is the strictest instance of the schema's general rule and it is struck first, because this row's entire privacy claim is that a NAMED INDIVIDUAL is the anchor: a bare name is simultaneously the least discriminating evidence in the corpus and the most dangerous thing to act on. `Jordan Lee.pdf` establishes nothing.

THE WORD DEPOSITION, TESTIMONY, EXAMINATION, TRANSCRIPT, WITNESS, DEPONENT, AFFIANT, SWORN, UNDER OATH, ERRATA, DESIGNATION or STATEMENT, ALONE OR IN COMBINATION. This is the charge this row had to answer and it is conceded in full: these are document-type words and the schema's own `work_type` enum already carries "witness statement, proof of evidence and deposition or hearing transcript" as a single VALUE. A row whose only evidence is that vocabulary IS the schema's default template with a narrower filename filter, and would deserve refusal. The row stands on the certificate-and-errata STRUCTURE or it does not stand.

A DOCUMENT-TYPE WORD BESIDE A PERSON'S NAME. `Deposition of Jordan Lee.pdf` is two struck tokens, not a structure, and it is exactly the escape route `business_operations.organisational-records` closed: a document-type word names no entity and resolves nothing about the first entity's role. It cannot tell you whether the person was examined, whether the file is the transcript or a summary of it, or whether the holder was in the room.

A COURT REPORTER'S, STENOGRAPHY BUREAU'S, TRANSCRIPTION-SERVICE'S or LEGAL-VIDEO COMPANY'S NAME, LOGO, COVER PAGE, FOOTER, ORDER FORM or WATERMARK. This one is true of the row's own collision fixtures: a bar-review sample transcript, a published hearing transcript and a licensed transcript of a public inquiry all carry the same branded cover, and a reporting company is exactly the kind of organisation 00's role-ambiguity reasoning covers - it appears as the producer of this examination, as the producer of somebody else's, as a vendor the firm is a customer of, and as a template author.

A COURT CAPTION, CASE NUMBER, DOCKET NUMBER, PROCEEDING IDENTIFIER, EXHIBIT STICKER, BATES-SHAPED TOKEN, VOLUME NUMBER, TAPE NUMBER or PAGE-AND-LINE COORDINATE, ALONE. A caption is `legal`'s signal and is satisfied by any public filing; a coordinate is an ADDRESS and supplies linkage only once the file it addresses has been established. Their digits are never a date.

A SWORN, UNDER-OATH, PENALTY-OF-PERJURY, CONFIDENTIAL, ATTORNEYS-EYES-ONLY, SEALED or SUBJECT-TO-PROTECTIVE-ORDER LEGEND. The product preserves the literal observation and decides nothing about oath validity, perjury, admissibility, confidentiality designation, waiver, sealing or disclosure rights - and specifically, such a legend is not evidence that this row applies, since it is stamped on productions, expert reports and commercial exhibits constantly.

AN ALPHABETICAL WORD INDEX OR CONCORDANCE READ AS A SOURCE OF ENTITIES. It is accepted as a structural signal and refused as a source of facts, prompt content or folder levels, in the same breath. It is the most extractable structure in the file and every name in it belongs to someone who did not choose this filesystem.

A SOURCE TYPE OR EXTENSION ALONE, including audio_video and every media extension this row lists. A long .mp4 is not an examination and an examination is not a medium: `file_kind_plausible` is constitutionally never-alone, and a recorded deposition, a recorded webinar, a recorded interview and a recorded hearing are the same bytes to a container sniffer.

A DURATION, A SEGMENT COUNT, A TAPE LABEL or ANY RECORDING METADATA. Duration is what 00 says the extractor yields; it is not what the recording is of, and speech-to-text is not available to close the gap except "only under an explicit privacy and compute policy".

A FILENAME OR FOLDER containing depo, deposition, transcript, testimony, witness, statement, errata, volume, final or signed. Paths stay local, an existing folder supports review only, and a folder name is an unlabelled position.

AUTHOR, CREATOR, PRODUCER or LAST-SAVED-BY METADATA naming a reporter, a transcription tool, a firm or a practitioner. 00: "It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension", and a witness statement's producer metadata names the practitioner who drafted it, not the person whose evidence it is - which is precisely the fact this row must not confuse.

DOWNLOAD-SESSION, THREAD, ARCHIVE or CURRENT-DIRECTORY MEMBERSHIP. 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic". A transcript, an exhibit set and three media segments that arrived together are a delivery, not necessarily one examination.

MATCHING PERSON NAMES, SUBJECT MATTER, DATES or SEMANTIC SIMILARITY ACROSS TWO EXAMINATIONS OR TWO MATTERS. Cross-examination and cross-matter bridging is suppressed unless an exact explicit reference or a user decision authorises it. One person may be examined in several unrelated matters and joining those files would build a dossier on them that no one asked for.

PUBLIC AVAILABILITY of a transcript, a filed excerpt or a televised examination as proof that the local copy, the examination around it, or the deponent's other testimony is low-sensitivity or eligible for a cloud prompt.

work_types: subpoena or summons to a named individual, with or without a document schedule
scheduling, cancellation and re-notice correspondence for an examination
rough draft, realtime or uncertified transcript feed
certified verbatim transcript, by volume or day
condensed or four-up rendering of a transcript
alphabetical word index or concordance to a transcript
audio or video recording of an examination, by segment
exhibit marked on a deponent during an examination
errata, correction or read-and-sign sheet, and signature waiver
deposition summary, digest or key-testimony note
witness statement, proof of evidence or signed declaration
witness statement exhibit bundle referenced by initials-and-number
reporter or transcription-service invoice and order form
grouping_reasons: ONE EXAMINATION OF ONE PERSON, joined by an exact examination reference or by the certificate's own attested date-and-place pair: the notice, the rough draft, the certified volumes, the media segments, the marked exhibits, the word index and the errata sheet. This is the row's primary anchor and it is deliberately NOT the matter reference the schema's default uses - a transcript served by another party may carry none. Content-incoherent and purpose-coherent, which is 00's licence for the group: "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent." The anchor supports candidate membership; it copies no person, party, matter or date fact onto any member.

ONE TRANSCRIPT ACROSS ITS RENDERINGS - rough draft, certified, condensed, word-indexed, OCR'd scan - as the universal version_family fact, supported by hashes, certification markers or explicit revision markers. A `-final` or `-signed` suffix never establishes it.

ONE EXAMINATION AND THE ARTEFACTS THAT ADDRESS INTO IT BY COORDINATE: a designation table, a summary keyed to page-and-line, a brief quoting page-and-line. The coordinate is an exact explicit reference and is the strongest join this row has. The designation table joins the transcript without becoming it, and without acquiring the deponent as a fact.

ONE EXAMINATION SERIES within one matter where several volumes or days share one examination reference. Two examinations of the same person in the same matter are joined ONLY by an exact reference, never by the shared name.

A WITNESS STATEMENT AND ITS EXHIBIT BUNDLE, joined by the initials-and-number exhibit marker the statement itself defines. The marker is defined inside the statement, which is why it is an explicit reference and not a filename convention.

NO GROUP AT ALL is a valid and common outcome. A single certified transcript with nothing around it is still protected material, and `legal`'s licence covers it from the neighbouring side: "Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold."

NOT grouping reasons, stated so they are not reached for: the deponent's name recurring across matters; a shared reporting company; a shared examination date; a shared court caption; a shared delivery archive; and the general stop rule, "It should not form a supported group when there is no valid anchor".

template.why: EMPTY BY CONTRACT - a dimension may only branch on a field the same schema declares, and `law_practice` declares none under PR-6 - and empty a second time because this row's material co-activates `legal`, a safety domain whose protection runs before any placement decision. THE RECOMMENDATION HELD AS PROSE, AND IT IS WHERE THIS ROW DIVERGES FROM ITS SCHEMA'S DEFAULT, WHICH IS LEG 2 OF THE NODE TEST. The schema's default recommendation is: client (only if the corpus spans several AND the user approved a client-named branch), then MATTER, then DOCUMENT FUNCTION, then period last. Two of those four levels break here. FIRST, the natural anchor of this row is not the matter - it is the DEPONENT, one named natural person, and the schema's default template already bans a named third party from ever being a folder level, however strong the grouping axis. For every other template in the family that ban is a side constraint on a usable structure; here the ban lands on the row's own primary anchor, so this row must state a substitute rather than inherit a recommendation. The substitute is: MATTER, then EXAMINATION FUNCTION as a single level holding the whole examination package together, then the EXAMINATION DATE, with the deponent held as a grouping key that is never written into a path. SECOND, that promotes period from last to third, and the row states plainly why that is not a violation of 00's ordering rule rather than hiding it: the examination date is not a capture date and not a filesystem date - it is the attested date on the officer's certificate, it is the only thing that separates Volume II of one person's second examination from Volume II of their first, and it is doing WITHIN-MATTER discrimination rather than acting as a top level. 00's rule is about the top level - "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." - and the matter still comes first, so `time_first` is FALSE and no sibling may read this as licence to claim the photos exception. THIRD, function must follow the matter because a child is unintelligible without its parent: 00's own argument is "A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known, and a course code may require the school or term to disambiguate it.", and an errata sheet, a Volume II or a designation table is meaningless without the examination and the matter it belongs to. A FOURTH RULE BINDS ONLY THIS ROW: the media segments must not be split from the transcript into a media branch by source_type. Splitting a package by file kind is the one placement that would break the coordinate relationship the whole family is built on, and it is the placement a naive extension-driven tree produces first. And whatever lands stays a recommendation: "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions."

sensitivity_why: The protected person here is usually NOT the holder and usually NOT the holder's client. A deponent is compelled by a notice or subpoena, is frequently a non-party, and the artefact is a complete verbatim record of everything they said under examination — which routinely includes their address, employment history, medical history, finances and family relationships, elicited by an adversary and preserved word for word. Three properties make the posture specific to this row rather than inherited from the schema. FIRST, the WORD INDEX: a certified transcript ships with an alphabetical concordance of every proper name and substantive term spoken, which makes the file the most machine-extractable dossier on a private individual in the whole law_practice family, and it is detected in order to be protected — never read as a source of entities, facts or prompt content. SECOND, the RECORDING: this is the only row in the family whose primary artefact set includes audio and video of a real person, and 00 permits speech-to-text "only under an explicit privacy and compute policy", so no transcription may be run to improve classification. THIRD, CROSS-EXAMINATION BRIDGING: one person may be examined in several unrelated matters, and joining those files by their name would assemble a testimony history on them that nobody asked for, so name-based bridging is suppressed as a privacy rule and not only as an accuracy rule. Any confidentiality, attorneys-eyes-only, sealed or protective-order legend on the file stays a literal observation; the product decides no legal status. And nothing here may reach a remote model by default — 00: "If a model needs text containing sensitive content, the user should see that requirement and choose whether to allow a local model, a cloud model, a redacted prompt, or no model use." P7 owns handling classes; this row assigns none.
open_question: Four, none of them smoothed. (1) NJ-DEP-1, THE ABSORPTION SEAM, and it is the row's weakest joint: the roster directs this row to absorb the legacy `law.witness-statements`, and it does, on the argument that a deposition and a signed witness statement are both ONE NAMED INDIVIDUAL'S OWN ATTESTED EVIDENCE, anchored on the person rather than on the matter, with the statement of truth standing where the oath certificate stands. The honest counter-argument is that a statement is DRAFTED BY THE PRACTITIONER and only signed, so it is work product with a signature, and its natural neighbour is `law_practice.trial-preparation` or the matter file rather than a verbatim examination. Alternatives for R1c: (a) keep the absorption as written, which is this row's recommendation, because the attestation slot and the person-anchor are what activation actually uses; (b) split witness statements out to their own row, which this row opposes as a document-type split; (c) route statements to `law_practice.trial-preparation` and let this row hold only certified examinations, which would leave the legacy id homeless where no hearing is in prospect. (2) NJ-DEP-2, THE EXAMINATION ANCHOR HAS NO KEY. This row's primary grouping anchor is an EXAMINATION — one person, one sitting, several volumes and media segments — and there is no canonical key for it. The row deliberately declines to mint `examination_id`, `deposition_id`, `proceeding_ref` or `transcript_id`, and asks R1c whether the anchor is (a) an instance of the schema's `project` reuse at a finer grain, (b) a grouping-only construct that needs no key at all, which is this row's own reading under PR-6, or (c) a genuine gap. It must not be resolved by 36 template authors independently. (3) NJ-DEP-3, THE PERIOD LEVEL. This row's recommendation promotes the examination date above the schema default's period-last rule, on the argument that it is a within-matter discriminator between volumes of the same person's examinations and not a top level. If R1c judges that this contradicts "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.", the fallback is to drop the date level entirely and let version_family and explicit volume markers carry the separation — the row does NOT ask for `time_first: true` under any reading. (4) NJ-DEP-4, THE WORD INDEX AS A PRODUCT-WIDE PROBLEM, raised here because this row meets it first but not only here: an artefact that ships with a machine-readable concordance of the people named inside it is a category no design document addresses, and the same shape occurs on a privilege log, a bundle index and a transcript. Options: (a) a corpus-wide rule that a concordance-shaped structure is never an entity source, which this row assumes and cannot enact alone; (b) a P7 handling decision; (c) leave it per-row, which will produce eleven inconsistent versions of it.
